description.value: Café Medina is a Mediterranean-inspired brunch destination in the heart of downtown Vancouver, open since 2008 and recognized by the Michelin Guide every year since 2022. The restaurant is celebrated for its signature Belgian waffles, eclectic bistro fare, and connoisseur-level coffee in a bright, open space with soaring ceilings and an open kitchen. It also hosts private evening events for up to 70 guests in its curated private dining room.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence across multiple subpages. The postal code differs between OSM (V6B 3A4) and the website (V6B 0C8), so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website; takeout is confirmed via an 'Online Order' navigation link, and vegetarian/GF options are explicitly confirmed in the FAQ.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM lists V6B 3A4 but the website consistently shows V6B 0C8. Website value used.
No bike parking of any kind is mentioned on the website or in OSM tags — a gap for a cycling directory listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Café Medina is a well-established, Michelin-recognized brunch destination in downtown Vancouver with vegetarian and GF options and online ordering — a useful fuel stop for touring cyclists passing through the city core.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms GF options ('some of our dishes can be prepared without wheat, and we also offer gluten-free option') and vegetarian dishes ('we serve some vegetarian dishes made with fresh, seasonal ingredients'); several menu items are explicitly marked 'can be vegetarian'
